title: read_dot_terminated has no size cap — OOM before 441 rejection
description: reader/src/session/commands/post.rs: read_dot_terminated() accumulates all bytes into a Vec with no size limit. The 1 MiB check (DEFAULT_MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES) happens only in complete_post(), after the entire article has been read. A client streaming a 4 GB article with no dot-terminator will OOM the server before the size check fires. Same problem exists in transit/src/peering/session.rs read_dot_stuffed(). Fix: pass max_bytes into the reader and return Err if exceeded mid-read.
